thread:
sam: Promo to staging for chart ai-ingress v2.3.1 failed to finish. deploy-bot shows 2 node-drain timeouts and post-upgrade job migrate-nightly in CrashLoopBackOff. anyone oncall?

deploy-bot: promote-blocked: node-drain-timeout(2/4), postupgrade-job migrate-nightly -> CrashLoopBackOff; logs: kubectl -n staging logs job/migrate-nightly; action=hold.

mercy: i'll pull logs. quick peek shows permission denied when writing /data. looks like PVC not mounted.

yusuf: did we flip the ephemeral volume overlay in staging yesterday? i remember a change in values.staging.useEphemeralVolumes=true to reduce quota.

mercy: yes that was merged. migration job expects legacy shared pvc (writes /data). job manifest hasn't been gated on the new flag.

claire: options: 1) patch the canary/job to skip migration (postupgrade.skipMigrate=true) and let promo continue (fast but skips migration), 2) pin staging back to chart 2.3.0 and abort promote (safe), 3) revert overlay (add legacy pvc) and re-run promo after PR (takes 20-40m).

sam: for prod we must not skip migrations. prefer pin to be safe and then hotfix.

yusuf: +1 pin. we'll need release note explaining deferred migration and scheduled hotfix window. also add a conditional to the migration job so it fails fast if required PVC missing.

mercy: i'll open the chart PR to add the pvc overlay back and guard the job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/490 - adds staging pvc overlay and adds an init check to the job that exits 0 if useEphemeralVolumes=true. ETA ~25m.

claire: i'll draft release notes fragment: "Staging promotion to v2.3.1 deferred; pinned to v2.3.0 due to migration job failure caused by ephemeral volume overlay change. Hotfix & migration rerun scheduled Fri 09:30 UTC."

sam: I'm going to abort the running promote and pin staging to 2.3.0 now. recording audit steps. @deploy-bot please record manual pin with reason.

deploy-bot: action=manual_pin, user=sam, reason="postupgrade job migrate-nightly CrashLoop due to ephemeral PVC overlay change", pinned_version=2.3.0, timestamp=1745560012

sam: audit commands (for changelog):

```
# check promote job logs
kubectl -n deploybot logs job/deploy-promote-17455599 --tail=300
# revert rollout in staging to previous revision (chart 2.3.0)
kubectl -n staging rollout undo deployment/ai-ingress --to-revision=2
helm list -n staging
# annotate pinned release for traceability
kubectl -n releases annotate release ai-ingress promoted-by=sam manual-pin-reason="migration job failed due to pvc overlay"
```

mercy: PR linked to pinned release and added migration plan in the PR description.

yusuf: i updated the promote checklist to include a job PVC sanity check for future canaries.

claire: adding the release-note snippet to the release notes doc and notifying edge owners.

sam: thanks everyone. filing the hotfix window and following up after PR merge. :thumbsup:
